Subject: RE: Realtime API errors - Valence (initial triage)

Quick update from SRE triage: we see a rapid cache eviction event in the prefix cache cluster that coincided with a configuration rollout at 08:59 UTC. The eviction caused increased backend load, amplified by aggressive client retry patterns, which resulted in elevated 429s and downstream 5xx errors.

Mitigations applied (09:35–09:44 UTC):
- Enabled rate-limits and temporary concurrency caps for Valence project to stabilize backend load.
- Rerouted 40% of Valence traffic to model-variant-b (lower resource profile but more predictable latency).
- Shortened idle KV timeout to reduce memory pressure.
- Posted interim incident note on status.redwood: https://status.redwood.com/incidents/INC-8472

Impact now: error rate is decreasing but still above baseline (5xx rate ~0.9% down from 7.4%; 429s at ~1.2%). ETA for full remediation: ~2 hours for rollback of the faulty rollout or a safe config patch. We'll continue to monitor and provide cadence updates every 60 minutes or on significant status changes.

Evelyn Hart
SRE Lead, Redwood Inference
